project_name: Materials Hub - SAP BOM/MRP Supplier & Vendor Portal
design_context: B2B External Vendor Portal (SAP Materials Hub)
emotional_archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast meets Performance Pro (Precision, Industrial Authority, Crisp Workflow)
theme: Light theme default with rich Slate/Obsidian contrast elements, sharp metrics hierarchy, and crisp interactive states

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, or General Sans (Modern Industrial Display)
typography.body_font: IBM Plex Sans, DM Sans, or Inter

navigation_structure.layout: Persistent Left Sidebar + Top Header bar with Quick Actions & Vendor Profile Badge
header_features: Vendor Code + Name Badge (e.g. VEND-88402 | Apex Precision Components)
SAP Sync Status Indicator ('SAP ERP Connected')

dashboard.title: Vendor Control Center
sections: Company Profile Summary Card (Vendor Code, GSTIN/Tax ID, Payment Terms, MSME Category, ERP Rating)
Key Metric Bento Cards (Active POs, Total Outstanding Qty, In-Transit Shipments, Open QC NCs)
Actionable Assigned Purchase Orders Table with remaining qty highlight & quick dispatch action

shipments.title: In-Transit Shipments & Dispatch Tracking
sections: Shipment Summary Bar (In Transit, Discrepancy, Received, Rejected)
Create Shipment Modal / Form (PO line item selection, ASN number, Lorry receipt / Tracking #, expected delivery date, driver details)
Shipment History Table with Status Filter, inline item details, & Edit Shipment drawer

documents.title: Vendor Compliance & Statutory Documents
sections: Mandatory Upload Cards: MSME Registration Certificate & Bank Details / Cancelled Cheque
Version History Log (Revision history, timestamp, verified status, download link - NEVER deleted, audit trail preserved)
Document Upload Form with File Validation and Expiry Tracking

audits_qc.title: Audits & Quality Control (QMS Integration)

banner.text: DEMO DATA DISCLOSURE: The QMS Integration feed is currently operating in Preview/Demo mode. Data shown below illustrates real-time Q-Notifications and Audit Non-Conformances once live QMS API sync is finalized.

sections: QC Metrics Overview (Total Q-Notifications, Open Audit NCs, CAP Pending Action, Pass Rate %)
Tab 1: Q-Notifications List (Defect type, Material Code, Affected Qty, Inspection Lot #, Severity, Status)
Tab 2: Audit Non-Conformances (NC #, Audit Date, Finding Description, ISO Standard Clause, Risk Level)
Corrective Action Plan (CAP) Submission Form / Modal (Root Cause Analysis text area, Immediate Containment Action, Corrective Action Plan, Target Completion Date, Evidence File Upload)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, nav items, inputs, table rows, modals, tabs) include meaningful `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-audits-qc', data-testid='submit-cap-button', data-testid='qms-demo-banner').
Do NOT use teal green/blue (#1B93A4 or #0E7C86) for primary surfaces. Use crisp Slate/Indigo/Blue palette.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk font.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for actions (Shipment created, Document uploaded, CAP submitted).
Ensure persistent left sidebar with clean collapsible mobile menu and active route highlight.
Provide demo data disclosure banner on the Audits & QC page prominently at the top.
Keep full functional backward compatibility for login/JWT auth and existing supplier API endpoints while dramatically improving UI polish.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6, gap-6, py-8) to prevent visual clutter
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.borders: 1px crisp slate-200 borders with subtle hover highlights
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.micro_interactions: Smooth transition-colors and hover:translate-y-[-1px] for card buttons
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.accessibility: High contrast WCAG AA compliant text over light backgrounds
